The blur is significant and likely a mix of low-res source and generation softness. The Topology Auditor's mask confirms the main body is coherent, but it cannot detect the subtle fusion of the cord. The Depth Auditor confirms proper grounding, ruling out floating artifacts. The severity of the blur impacts the overall quality significantly, preventing a high artifact score despite good structural integrity.
